The dDocent pipeline expects paired FASTQ files named after the sample: ``Locality_Individual.F.fq.gz`` and ``Locality_Individual.R.fq.gz``. The wrapper renames the collection elements accordingly, so the only requirements on the element identifiers are:
* no whitespace or slashes, and * an underscore separating locality and individual, e.g. ``PopA_01``.
When no popmap is supplied, the population of a sample is taken as the part of its name before the first underscore (``PopA_01`` belongs to population ``PopA``).

param.label: CD-HIT clustering similarity (-c)
param.help: Similarity threshold used by CD-HIT to collapse assembled sequences into reference contigs. 0.9 is the value recommended by dDocent.

param.label: K1: minimum within-individual coverage to include a read in the assembly
param.help: Low-coverage reads are the ones most likely to be sequencing errors; 5 is dDocent's suggested starting point. Run the ReferenceOpt.sh survey (outside Galaxy) if you need to explore this parameter.

param.label: K2: minimum number of individuals a read must be present in
param.help: Suggested starting point is roughly 10% of the number of individuals. Both K1 and K2 must be given, otherwise dDocent asks for them interactively.

param.label: Assembly type
param.help: The read layout used for the reference assembly. RPE (randomly sheared paired-end), OL (paired-end with substantial overlap) and HYB (a mixture of the two) are the specialised alternatives to the default ddRAD PE layout; OL and HYB merge overlapping read pairs with PEAR and are noticeably slower.
param.option: HYB - a mixture of overlapping and non-overlapping paired-end fragments

param.label: BWA mismatch penalty (B)
param.help: dDocent's recommended default is 4; the Configuration_example distributed with dDocent uses 3.

param.label: BWA gap-open penalty (O)
param.help: dDocent's recommended default is 6; the Configuration_example distributed with dDocent uses 5.
